title: A normalized exact tensor square descends to arbitrary derived localizations
statement: Let B,E,F,H be closed braided Grothendieck abelian monoidal categories with additive tensor, small colimits, functorial flat resolutions and chosen derived-category localization universes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, lem-sfb-derived-monoidal]. Let L:B→E, Lprime:F→H, S:B→F and T:E→H be additive exact flat-preserving functors preserving countable colimits. Equip all four functors and their exact derived functors with strong monoidal structures. Suppose an ordinary natural isomorphism o:L⋙T≅S⋙Lprime satisfies TensorSquare [def-sfb-derived-projection-comparison-squares], the four chosen derived structures satisfy TensorNormalization, and i:DL⋙DT≅DS⋙DLprime satisfies LeftLocalizationCondition at o [def-sfb-constant-module-derived-comparison-data]. Then the four chosen derived structures satisfy TensorSquare at i. The assertion constructs no monoidal structure and has no geometric or constant-scalar data.

proof.text: Choose functorial flat-term K-flat resolutions of both source complexes. Their images under L and S and the two composites are K-flat, since these exact flat-preserving functors preserve flat-term K-flat complexes. Their localization maps are isomorphisms.

proof.text: On these models use the four TensorNormalization equations. Precompose with the image of the source localization tensorator and postcompose with the tensor of the exact-factorization isomorphisms and the target localization tensorator. These arrows are invertible on the chosen models. Substitute LeftLocalizationCondition at the two models and their tensor total. Naturality of the exact factors reduces the equality to localization of the cochain tensor square.

proof.text: The cochain square commutes on every degree p,q coproduct summand by the ordinary TensorSquare hypothesis. The standard cochain comparison is the signed total of the ordinary comparison; additivity respects signs and preservation of countable coproducts respects totals. Thus the entire cochain square commutes.

proof.text: Cancel the invertible arrows to obtain the derived square on the resolved models. Naturality transports along the resolution isomorphisms to arbitrary derived objects in both variables. The four normalizations leave no freedom to change the tensor maps, regardless of the chosen localization universes.
